_comment: ADR-037 register fragment — source nested-auth write-only paths (ocon#235 secret half, adopting openregister#459). SECURITY FIX. The top-level source credentials went writeOnly in ocon#147 phase 2 (99-source-secrets-writeonly.json), but the OAuth/JWT credentials an operator authors under the UNTYPED `configuration` object stayed plaintext-readable, because OpenRegister resolved writeOnly from TOP-LEVEL schema properties only (RenderObject::getWriteOnlyProperties iterates $schema->getProperties()) — a marker nested under `configuration.authentication.client_secret` stripped nothing, and blanket-writeOnly on `configuration` is not viable (the whole object is legitimately read back to populate the editor). openregister#459 adds the missing declaration surface: `x-openregister-writeonly-paths`, a schema-level annotation listing dot-paths from the object root. A declared path AND its whole sub-tree are stripped on EVERY rendered read — unconditionally, admins included, list/search included (openregister#460/#462), plus the `@self.relations` mirror (SaveObject::scanForRelations flattens nested values into literal dot-path keys, so a nested secret leaks there too). WHY THESE FOUR AND NOT THE OTHER AUTH KEYS: the engine reads these through CallService::call(), which since ocon#236 re-resolves the source with `_render: false` (resolveSourceForDispatch, CallService.php ~L2141) BEFORE it touches auth — `_render: false` is the load-bearing argument, NOT `_rbac: false` (the strip is SCHEMA-gated at RenderObject::schemaHasWriteOnlyRule, so an `_rbac: false` read still loses the value; that was the ocon#212/#226 lesson). Twig templates keep resolving `{{ source.configuration.authentication.client_secret }}` because renderValue() is handed that same RAW $sourceData (CallService.php:256/863). DELIBERATELY NOT MARKED: `username` and `client_id` are identifiers, not secrets — this mirrors the top-level overlay, which marks apikey/secret/password/jwt/authenticationConfig but deliberately NOT username/jwtId. `authentication` is an auth-STRATEGY string ('body'/'basic_auth'), not a credential. `credentialRef` is a reference the broker MUST keep reading (BrokeredCallService). `grant_type`/`scope`/`algorithm`/`payload`/`x5t`/`tokenUrl`/`tokenLocation`/`passwordType` are non-secret call parameters. `encryptedToken` and the `mtls.*` bundle are NOT marked here even though they are secrets: six direct-Guzzle clients (IStandaardenClient, DsoClient, KissKlantinteractiesClient, StufZknClient, FscDirectoryClient, RestNotifyNlProvider) bypass CallService entirely and read the source through a plain RENDERED findAll(), then fail CLOSED when the credential is absent — marking those paths would take every one of those bridges down. They are already encrypted at rest via ICrypto, so the residual is a ciphertext read, not a plaintext leak. Tracked separately; the fix is to give those clients the same raw re-resolve CallService already performs. A malformed path, or a root segment naming an undeclared property, ABORTS the save (openregister#459 deliberately exempts this annotation from openregister#419's drop-the-bad-key isolation — silent degradation on a security annotation is fail-open); `configuration` is a declared top-level property of `source`, so these paths are well-rooted. Version bumped 1.2.0 -> 1.3.0: OpenRegister re-imports a schema only when the incoming version exceeds the stored one, so a content change without a bump is a silent no-op on existing installs.
